answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The saffron is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ripple. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim.
